sections.heading: Why ATS resume compression requires vector text preservation.
body: Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) scan the raw text and embedded fonts of your PDF resume. Naive online PDF compressors convert vector text into compressed raster images, destroying your resume's searchability and causing automated ATS rejection.
Zcompressor compresses embedded background graphics and photo assets while leaving text nodes intact as true vectors, ensuring ATS parsers can read every keyword clearly.

faq.q: Will compressing my resume PDF affect ATS parsing?
faq.a: Not with Zcompressor! Zcompressor preserves embedded text fonts and structural metadata required by ATS parsers while compressing high-resolution headshots or design elements.
